description: General hardware engineering: system composition and review, harnesses and fastener stack-ups, test and measurement, BOM export, evidence coverage. Releases are @protoboardai/ext-release.

skills.summary: Start here: the top-level SOP from an idea or a brief to a release, one level of detail at a time (concept of 3 to 6 blocks, blocks, parts, definitions verified, schematic and PCB), asking before each level deeper — sourcing, parts by tier, system and harnesses, boards, enclosures and structures, harness CAD, checks, firmware, documents, Manufacturing Package, evals — delegating to each extension's SOP
Brief → requirements → module selection → UHD system (links, harnesses, mates) → fault scenarios → the protoboard check loop, with every diagnostic code explained
Independent review of a composed system against its brief: requirement trace, link and harness justification, diagnostic dispositions, scenario coverage
Wire harnesses (conductors, lengths, gauges, connectors) and fastener stacks (stack-up arithmetic, supplier-cited hardware, nut engagement, torque)
Independently re-derive every stack-up, thread engagement, torque and cable fact from the sources
Test plan from requirements and the model, procedures, and measured test-data files (status standin|measured) that replace stand-in data in the documents

operations.summary: Write the bill of materials (quantities multiplied through the instance tree, with origins) to docs/bom.md and docs/bom.json

checks.summary: Every purchased part used has cited sources and a recorded verification
